title: Planet Labs indefinite imagery blackout on Iran/Middle East at US request
snippet: Planet Labs indefinitely suspended distribution of satellite imagery covering Iran and broader Middle East conflict zones following US government request. Restriction retroactive to March 9, 2026. Access granted only case-by-case for mission-critical requirements. Vantor (formerly Maxar) and BlackSky also implemented tighter controls.
tag_reason: 상업 위성영상 배포 정책 변화 — 이전 보고서에서 다루지 않은 신규 이슈. 위성 OSINT 투명성에 구조적 영향.
